candidate_contract: Single-frame RGBA PNG without ICC; unchanged verified source/renderer/transform

edge_resampling_family.approval: Separate proposed group rule; no approval inferred from the old global-alpha screen
edge_resampling_family.reason: Allow only measured edge-localized filter differences; reject interior opacity/color, support or geometry changes
edge_resampling_family.unchanged_visual_thresholds: All original black/white composite bounds except global alpha MAE

exceptions: Outside bounds requires explicit exact individual acceptance; missing/case mappings require separate decisions

filename_policy.published_case_renames: Only exact approved source-basename corrections; paired index deletion/addition in one commit
filename_policy.rule: Preserve the exact authoritative source asset basename in both sizes and public Git paths

scope: Exact measured membership only; both black/white composites must pass original visual bounds

limitations: Requires maintainer approval and negative-control calibration
Font substitutions and layout changes require scoped review
Global SSIM is a screen, not windowed structural similarity
Region boxes are conservative diagnostics, not text recognition
visual_policy.scope: unchanged overlay source, transformation, profile and placement; individually approved exceptions retained
